items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Was that the time when Bob Green was here?

ctx.x: Yeah, I hitchhiked from here, from Chicago. I came here in the morning and I saw Jeffy. I went down to Preservation Island and I saw him. I think it was a Saturday because that guitar player was playing like that. What is his name? Babe Stovall. Yeah, he was playing. I knowed him through a radio program from what I learned before. So I went in there and I was there. They had a jam session after that, which I also was with and I played a few songs. I sat in with Johnny Wicks and Raymond Burke. And since then…
Was that the time when Bob Green was here?
